description: Four criteria for synthetic transportation project prioritization. Scores are synthetic.

criteria.name: Implementation Cost
criteria.description: Total financial outlay required to plan, build, and deploy the transportation project. Lower values are preferred because they indicate a more cost-efficient investment.

criteria.name: Accessibility Improvement
criteria.description: Expected increase in transport accessibility and mobility for users, measured by a synthetic index. Higher values indicate better access and connectivity benefits.

criteria.name: Environmental Benefit
criteria.description: Estimated reduction in negative environmental impacts or improvement in ecological outcomes from the project, represented by a synthetic index. Higher values indicate stronger environmental gains.

criteria.name: Implementation Time
criteria.description: Expected duration required to complete project delivery and operational launch. Shorter times are preferred because they reduce delays and allow benefits to be realized sooner.
